newsitem.title: CANADA: Trizec sets Central Europe joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Trizec sets Central Europe joint venture.

text.p: Trizec Corp Ltd said on Thursday it signed a 50/50 joint venture deal with Hungary's Polus Investments Ltd to develop shopping centers, mixed-use office projects and business parks in Central Europe.
It said the venture was examining a number of potential developments, including projects in Budapest, Hungary, and Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia.

Polus officially opened Hungary's first modern office building, Bank Center, in downtown Budapest and was now building the country's first modern retail shopping center, Polus Center, due to open in November this year, it said.
Trizec, one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate companies, is currently the subject of a merger proposal from Horsham Corp, which owns 48 percent of its stock.
